summary: Heavybit calls itself the leading investor in enterprise infrastructure, investing from day zero in technical startups since 2013. Its homepage states $500,000 to $5,000,000 from inception to Series A; the FAQ describes a typical initial check of $500,000 to $3,000,000 in a pre-seed round, scaling up at seed and Series A, and a focus on developer tools, AI, cloud-native infrastructure, open source, DevOps and DevSecOps. Geography and a street address are not stated.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage states more than 90 startups launched since 2013; individual portfolio companies are listed on the portfolio page without dates on the homepage.

sources.title: Homepage: enterprise infrastructure focus, check range and stage span
FAQ: company types, typical investment and year-round applications
